summary: Update E2E plugin tests to validate CLI-agnostic requirements and remove vendor-specific language assumptions in comments/descriptions.
migration_impact: No runtime changes; test updates ensure ongoing verification that the plugin remains free of CLI-vendor lock-in (Copilot, Grok, etc.).

2. The structure tests already assert no vendor-specific language in key files.
3. When adding new CLI-specific tests in future, follow the agnostic pattern (test the binary path separately, verify manifests are clean).
agent_notes: The plugin E2E suite now better reflects the CLI-agnostic design from the grok-build epic research/design. Use this as model for other agent surfaces.
